name: Kunneppu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kunneppu town emblem in white and black: a white disc bearing a black broken ring around the characters 訓.
history: Municipal flag of Kunneppu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 1951.

features.role: Kunneppu town emblem — a white disc bearing a black broken ring around the characters 訓
